details:
Q1. Which part of the repository should this issue change?
Choices:
A. The issue-to-PR pipeline workflows (clarify, plan or implement) (RECOMMENDED)
B. Review and autofix (`review_autofix.yml` and its helpers)
C. The orchestrator and poller (`orchestrate_poll.yml` and `scripts/orchestrate_*`)
D. Documentation only (README, `docs/`)
E. Other: name the file, workflow or feature
Q2. What is wrong today, or what goal should "better" serve?
Choices:
A. A specific bug or failing run: give the run ID, error text or log lines (RECOMMENDED)
B. Speed or cost: fewer runner jobs, fewer API calls, fewer tokens
C. Reliability: fewer stuck states or failed runs, better self-healing
D. Clarity for users or operators: clearer comments, alerts or docs
E. Other: describe it
Q3. How will we know the work is done?
Choices:
A. A specific behaviour or output changes in a way you describe, with a test that checks it (RECOMMENDED)
B. A metric you name reaches a threshold you name (for example run count, run time or failure rate)
C. A named failing workflow run or issue now succeeds
D. Other: describe it
